description: Trigger and behavior evaluations for the humanizer skill. The description in SKILL.md is the trigger; these cases check that it fires on real humanizing requests and stays quiet on unrelated ones.
how_to_run: Manual: in a fresh Claude Code session with the skill installed, paste each prompt and record whether the humanizer skill was invoked (should_trigger) and whether the output matches the expectation. Repeat across Claude Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus, since trigger sensitivity varies by model. There is no automated harness in this repo; the optional cli/ tool scores rewrite quality but does not test triggering.

cases.prompt: Humanize this: In today's rapidly evolving landscape, AI is reshaping how we think about creativity, marking a pivotal moment.
cases.expect: Invokes humanizer in rewrite mode. Output is specific, varied human prose with no 'rapidly evolving landscape', 'reshaping', or 'pivotal', and zero em dashes.

cases.prompt: Can you make this sound less AI and more human? 'Our platform leverages cutting-edge technology to deliver a seamless, robust experience.'
cases.expect: Invokes humanizer. Removes 'leverages', 'cutting-edge', 'seamless', 'robust'; replaces with concrete specifics.

cases.prompt: Does this read like ChatGPT wrote it? Give it an AI score. 'It is important to note that this comprehensive guide delves into the intricacies of the subject.'
cases.expect: Invokes humanizer in detect mode with --score. Reports a high 0-100 score and flags P7 (AI vocabulary), P18/P22 (filler/formal), P29 (comprehensive overview).

cases.prompt: Remove the AI tells from this paragraph before I publish it on LinkedIn.
cases.expect: Invokes humanizer, ideally --voice professional. Strips emojis, hashtags, and significance inflation; adds concrete detail.

cases.prompt: Run the humanizer on docs/intro.md and fix the AI writing in place.
cases.expect: Invokes humanizer in edit mode on the file, making targeted Edit-tool changes rather than a full rewrite to chat.

cases.prompt: Translate this to French: The cat sat on the mat and watched the rain.
cases.expect: Does NOT invoke humanizer. Performs a translation.

cases.prompt: Write me a short poem about the ocean at night.
cases.expect: Does NOT invoke humanizer. Writes an original poem (humanizer rewrites existing AI-flavored text; it is not a general generator).

cases.prompt: Summarize this article in three bullet points.
cases.expect: Does NOT invoke humanizer. Produces a summary.
